cell_domain.generators: elementary integer axis boxes, each span [a,a] or [a,a+1]
cell_domain.orientation: increasing order of active coordinate axes
cell_domain.incidence: alternating upper minus lower faces in active-axis order
cell_domain.equivalence: equal spans within a declared scope denote shared support; projection equality does not identify source scopes
cell_domain.history: finite closure of declared top-cell support; construction lineages retained by fold records
cell_domain.boundary_window: all exposed codimension-one faces of fixed finite support

measures.occupancy: unsigned union of occupied cells, including cells with zero weight
measures.shared_faces: cancel only in signed boundary, remain in full complex and provenance
measures.overlap: coordinate-identical support within a scope is one occupied cell; distinct source scopes remain recorded before quotient projection
measures.quotient: fold image support counts target cell once, while retained preimages and oriented multiplicities remain separately available
measures.weights: nonnegative exact rationals for support; report metric uses positive rational axis lengths
measures.units: u^d with dimension d; u is a declared report coordinate, not an SI length
measures.independence: interior sums occupied top-cell weights; boundary cancels oriented incidences; independent exposed-face oracle tests absent top-cell neighbours

disk.object: closed unit disk x^2+y^2<=1 in declared Euclidean report coordinates
disk.refinement: dyadic grid; cells keep rational geometric coordinates by scaling integer vertices by 1/n
disk.outer_rule: minimum corner squared radius < n^2 on integer cells in [-n,n]^2
disk.boundary_estimator: sum exposed axial edge lengths with side 1/n, fixed at every level
disk.interior_estimator: occupied-cell area sum with weight 1/n^2, fixed at every level
disk.radius_estimator: maximum absolute vertex coordinate in each axis, requiring equality
disk.reference_independence: integer selection, weights, radius and refinement do not read pi/tau or evaluation values
disk.area_error: inner/outer inclusion is a deterministic enclosure; gap <= 8/n by quarter-column floor telescoping and ceiling correction; no distribution or sigma supplied
disk.limit_claim: same-disk area enclosure converges by gap <= 8/n; axial perimeter is exactly 8 at every level; no physical continuum claim

fold.domain: two adjacent occupied unit squares and every face
fold.codomain: one occupied unit square and every face
fold.law: x maps to min(x,2-x), y fixed; active reversal changes chain orientation
claims: retains source identities, scopes and construction lineage

pi_reference.numerical_bound: alternating partial sum and next partial sum enclose each arctangent; interval arithmetic combines them
